Operations & recovery

Check service readiness, understand continuity and find specialist operations. No recovery or restore runs automatically.

Planner default: deterministic fallback · Vision: not configured · Voice: not configured. Each run records the planner actually used. Configured services still require successful requests.

INTERRUPTED MISSION CONTINUITY
Restarted runs remain paused.
Inspect the mission, stop locks and recorded outcome.
Resume reconciles uncertain dispatches with the controller; it does not blindly replay them.
If evidence cannot settle the outcome, hold and investigate. Resume is explicit.
Choose a run to inspect
SIGNED BACKUPS — OPERATOR CLI

Run from the configured backend environment. Backups include authority and learning checkpoints. Verification must pass before restore. Keep signing keys and secrets separately.

python -m app.ops.backup create --out backups/
python -m app.ops.backup verify backups/<stamp>
Restore is a documented offline operation requiring the backend to be stopped. This workspace does not trigger it.
Open the recovery runbook ↗
SPECIALIST TESTING & OBSERVABILITY

The scenario lab and security drills have workspace controls. Adversarial/holdout validation, Prometheus metrics and external tracing have service/configuration workflows.
